function.name: calculate_portfolio_performance_metrics
function.description: Calculates various performance metrics for specified portfolios and compares them with a market benchmark.

portfolio_ids.description: A list of unique identifiers for the investment portfolios.

metrics.description: A list of performance metrics to calculate for each portfolio.

benchmark.description: The market benchmark to compare the portfolio performance against.

function.name: calculate_portfolio_var
function.description: Calculates the Value at Risk (VaR) for a portfolio based on historical trade data.

historical_data.description: The file containing historical trade data.

confidence_level.description: The confidence level for the VaR calculation.

time_horizon.description: The time horizon over which to calculate the VaR.

function.name: calculate_probable_maximum_loss
function.description: Calculates the probable maximum loss for a set of properties given a specific catastrophic event and confidence level.

property_ids.description: A list of property identifiers to evaluate for potential loss.

catastrophic_event.description: The type of catastrophic event to consider for the loss calculation.

confidence_level.description: The statistical confidence level for the probable maximum loss calculation.

function.name: calculate_production_efficiency
function.description: Calculates the production efficiency based on production data over a specified time frame.

production_data.description: The dataset containing timestamps of production cycles.

time_frame.description: The time frame for calculating efficiency, e.g., '30d' for the last 30 days.

function.name: calculate_quarterly_dividend
function.description: Calculates the quarterly dividend per share based on the total dividend payout and the number of outstanding shares.

function.name: calculate_repayment_schedule
function.description: Calculates the repayment schedule for a loan using specified parameters.
